title: Welcome to BlackLemon Studios
author: The Lemon
body:
Hi, and welcome to BlackLemon Studios. I (The Lemon) created this company to make apps and websites that help improve the internet and/or are pretty cool. My philosophy for apps and websites is 'No Ads and No Telemetry. When you sign in to one of my app for websites, it is stored securely on your device so you can log in later. Anyway, this is a fairly short blog, and I hope that some people see this and like it. I kindly request anyone who reads this to share my website with others, so I can increase my user base. If you have any issues with my philosophy, products or simply would like to talk, feel free to contact me via the feedback tab, email and also consider joining my WhatsApp channel.

- The Lemon.
